# LocaleBatch

> LocaleBatch checks a Shopify translations export locally, identifies supported product-text rows and demonstrates a fixed reviewed translation example.

Free browser tools. Paid features are not available.

Not a Shopify app or automatic store publisher. The free checker does not translate your catalog with AI. Paid translation, checkout and production delivery are not available.

## Documentation

- [Guide](https://localebatch.agiscorecard.com/guide)
